selectionBasis: Used the requested 85% numeric target. The existing characters were already approximately 86%, 93% and 91% of the default standing height, so this target reduces their size slightly.

shield.sizing: Uniform whole-body bind-mesh height ratio, cached when applying the skin. Preset enlargement is inherited once from the player transform.
shield.impactCoordinateConversion: Replicated player-local hit position converted into the resized shield's local coordinates.

coverage: Damage capsules and server hit history
Shield changes during character and preset switching
